settings.confirmSend:
Send the log contents to the developer?
** All identifiers will be removed **
settings.logSendFailed:
Failed to send after 5 attempts.
The error messages are at the end of the log.
settings.email: Email Address or Forum id (Required if you want me to respond)
settings.readRegister: First Register Address (use 0x before the number for hex input)
settings.pollingIntervalHint: Minimum is 10 seconds. Lower values update more frequently but can increase network and CPU usage.
settings.connectionModeHint: Automatic searches the network for inverters and works out the protocol, port and register map on its own. Manual disables all discovery and uses only the devices on the Manual Devices tab.
settings.devicesListHint: These devices are only used when the connection mode is set to Manual.
settings.selectDeviceFirst: Select a device in the list first.
settings.deviceIpRequired: Enter the IP address of the device.
settings.deviceSerialRequired: Enter the logger serial number. It is required for Solarman V5.
